MMM University of Technology Admission 2026 Online Form - Complete Details

MMM University of Technology Admission 2026 Online Form. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 20/06/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 27/05/2026
  • Last Date : 20/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/06/2026
  • Document Verification Date : 30 May to 22 June 2026
  • Choice Filling Date : 24 – 27 June 2026
  • All Category Candidates : Rs. 2500/-
  • Candidate Login : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 27/05/2026
  • Last Date : 20/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/06/2026
  • Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) : 292 Seats

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
